lede_html: Awards rose to 97 from 77 while tenders held at 31, so more of the pipeline is closing than opening. The big open packages are European: HEP d.d.'s US$528m civil structures and equipment tender in Croatia and Infraestruturas de Portugal's US$396m ETCS signalling lot, due 14 Jan. At the small end, Chinese contractors sit in the winning teams on World Bank-financed power awards in India and Ethiopia. For bidders, the sizeable open money this week is EU civil and rail work; on small multilateral power packages, plan to team with or price against Chinese suppliers.

deals_why.Main civil structures construction and e: HEP d.d. is buying civil works and equipment as one US$528m package, so civil contractors and equipment makers should line up consortia early; no deadline is listed yet.
deals_why.Railway signalling, lot S&T01: conventio: Infraestruturas de Portugal wants ETCS designed, built and maintained across conventional and high-speed sections; signalling suppliers have until 14 Jan to bid for US$396m.
deals_why.Track renewal to lift speed restrictions: CFR's Brașov branch is spending US$111m to lift speed restrictions on line 316; track contractors and rail suppliers have until 14 Dec to price it.
deals_why.Extension of Quay 9 and infill of Quay 8: The Port of Málaga is tendering US$53m of quay extension and infill for a multipurpose esplanade, a marine civil package closing 28 Dec.
deals_why.Petrobras PLSV pipelay contract: Petrobras has committed about US$410m to a PLSV charter with the Paratus/Seagems JV, which takes that pipelay vessel capacity in Brazil off the market.
deals_why.Natural gas distribution mains: rehabili: A four-firm Romanian consortium won US$47m of gas mains rehabilitation and new network work, so pipe and fittings suppliers should approach the winners now.
deals_why.Spennymoor 400kV: Costain has won the US$22m Spennymoor 400kV award, so on this UK transmission job suppliers now sell to the contractor, not the owner.
deals_why.Supply and installation: Brande Fjernvarme is tendering US$21m of supply and installation; no deadline is published, so interested suppliers should keep an eye on the TED notice.
deals_why.Construction of Service Reservoirs, Sola: Jiangxi Construction Eng Group took US$11.4m of World Bank-financed reservoir, solar and pumping work in Blantyre, with water and solar scope combined in one award.
deals_why.EPC- Restoration of 132 kV GIS Bageshwar: An India–China pairing won the US$6.1m Bageshwar 132 kV GIS restoration, which shows Chinese partners are competing for World Bank-funded Indian substation work.
deals_why.Design, Supply and Installation of Trans: A Laotian contractor teamed with Shandong Sino Ocean Electronic Technology to win US$5.8m of transformers and substation equipment, so local-plus-foreign JVs are winning World Bank work.
deals_why.Procurement of Supply, Installation, Ope: Holley Technology leads Beijing Eastwest on US$4.7m of stand-alone solar for 1,262 facilities in six lots, a low-value, high-volume contract to supply and maintain.
